d: We are looking for dynamic and self motivated Food & Beverage professionals who want to move their careers forward. As a Captain you are responsible to provide professional and customer focused service to our guests, ensuring their stay will become a memorable experience and your role will include key responsibilities such as:
Perform all necessary tasks to service food and beverage according to the standard of performance manual of the hotel
Acquire in depth knowledge of the food and beverage menu of the assigned outlet in order to assist and provide advice to guests
Practice good customer relations and attend to customer complaints and queries satisfactorily
Ensure the Outlet is set up for service and supervise for a smooth operation
Direct and supervise the service team to ensure that all duties are performed as per standards
Ensure that all colleagues have received adequate training to perform their duties
Ensure proper organization, planning and control of supplies and maintain concise record of all beverage stock in order to ensure that the required is available
Ensure minimum wastage, breakage and spoilage
Actively use up selling techniques by exceeding guest expectations and to increase revenue
q: You should ideally have a diploma degree in the hospitality field with a maximum of two years experiences in a similar role. You should possess a good knowledge in both written and spoken English and a wide familiarity with Micros would be desirable. Previous experiences in minor leadership and supervisory roles are a definite plus.

The ideal candidate will be customer driven and extremely proactives witched on individual with an outgoing, charismatic and approachable character. You will work well under pressure in a fast paced environment and be a great team player who thrives in working with a multicultural team and guests alike while possessing following additional competencies Understanding the JobTaking ResponsibilityRecognizing DifferencesCustomer FocusAdaptabilityTeamwork

d: The Homeroom Teacher at One International is responsible for creating a positive and engaging educational environment for students in grades K-6. This role involves delivering a comprehensive and dynamic curriculum, fostering student growth in core subjects such as language arts, science, social studies, civics, literature, and math. The teacher will design interactive lesson plans, provide constructive feedback, and ensure the holistic development of students in a nurturing and inclusive setting. The teacher will also be expected to embody and promote the school's core values of Education Excellence, Entrepreneurship, Holistic Wellness, and Culture & Global Insight.
q: Communication : Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to connect effectively with students, parents, and colleagues.
Adaptability : Flexibility in adapting to changing priorities, student needs, and educational innovations.
Problem-Solving : Analytical and problem-solving abilities, capable of addressing diverse student challenges and needs.
Collaboration : Ability to work collaboratively within a team and contribute to a positive school culture.
Commitment to Excellence : Dedication to professional growth and continuous improvement in teaching practices.
r: Develop and implement a balanced program of instruction, providing opportunities for students to observe, question, and explore, while emphasizing critical thinking and creativity.
Adapt teaching methods and materials to meet diverse student needs and interests, integrating clear objectives into all lessons that encourage lifelong learning.
Use various instructional strategies, including lectures, discussions, and hands-on activities, to engage students and enhance learning experiences.
Continuously update and modify lesson plans throughout the year to align with pacing and student progress.
Monitor and evaluate student performance, behavior, social development, and physical health.
Maintain accurate student records, including grading, portfolios, and other documentation as required by school policies.
Administer standardized tests and interpret results to inform instructional decisions and identify areas for student support.
Establish and enforce classroom rules and procedures to maintain a safe and respectful learning environment.
Create and maintain engaging and informative classroom displays that reflect student work and support the curriculum.
Manage student behavior using positive discipline techniques and approved procedures.
Communicate regularly with parents and guardians about student progress, behavior, and other relevant information.
Organize and participate in parent-teacher conferences, school events, and workshops to build strong relationships with families and engage them in their children's education.
Foster a welcoming environment for parents and guardians, encouraging open communication and collaboration.
Participate in professional development opportunities, educational conferences, and workshops to enhance teaching skills and stay current with educational trends.
Engage in training and development activities arranged by the school for continuous improvement.
Attend and actively participate in staff meetings, curriculum planning sessions, and school committees.
Collaborate with colleagues and administrators in curriculum development, program evaluation, and school-wide initiatives, with a focus on fostering innovation and risk-taking.
Organize and manage classroom resources, including materials and equipment, to support a rich learning environment.
Lead and support extracurricular activities, such as clubs and academic contests, to foster student interests and talents.
Integrate modern technology and digital tools into the classroom to enhance instructional delivery and student engagement.
Foster a culture of innovation and creativity, encouraging students to think critically and solve problems.
Promote mental and physical health and nutrition among students, integrating wellness education into daily routines and activities.
Instill a deep appreciation for Kuwaiti heritage and foster multicultural awareness, preparing students to thrive in a global society.
Participate in a formalized evaluation system that includes classroom observations by administrators, assessments of student progress, and self-reflection.
Performance evaluations will be based on criteria such as instructional effectiveness, classroom management, professional growth, and contributions to the school community.
Engage in community activities, including participation in cultural events and collaboration with local organizations.
Access support systems designed for new teachers, including mentoring programs, orientation sessions, and peer support groups.
Participate in school improvement initiatives, strategic planning, and curriculum review committees.
Contribute ideas and feedback to enhance the school's academic programs and overall educational experience.

d: leading regulated financial technology platform, powering seamless, smart, and inclusive finance. We connect the region's financial ecosystem, banks, fintechs, businesses and consumers, through a single platform built for impact. Combining open finance APIs, embedded financial journeys, real-time data intelligence, and secure payment solutions, we help our partners unlock new growth opportunities and deliver better financial experiences.

The Junior Sales Representative – IBAN Verification is responsible for driving the acquisition and onboarding of new clients onto our IBAN Verification solution within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Operating at the front line of our commercial engine, this role is the fastest path to revenue for the KSA business. The incumbent will identify, qualify, and close opportunities with banks, fintechs, e-commerce platforms, payroll providers, lending companies, and corporate clients who need to validate IBAN account ownership and reduce payment errors and fraud. Success in this role directly contributes to short-cycle revenue generation and the establishment of our market presence in the open banking ecosystem.
q: Diploma or bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Finance, or a related field.
Saudi national (preferred, in line with Saudization targets).
1–2 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management.
Prior exposure to fintech, payments, banking, or SaaS is a strong advantage.
Fresh graduates with strong commercial drive and a hunter mindset will be considered.
Strong communication and presentation skills in both Arabic and English.
Solid understanding of basic sales methodologies (prospecting, qualifying, closing).
Awareness of the KSA banking and fintech landscape, including open banking concepts and account verification use cases.
Proficiency in CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar) and MS Office / Google Workspace.
Strong negotiation skills and the resilience to handle rejection professionally.
Self-driven, target-oriented, and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
r: Identify, prospect, and generate qualified leads for the IBAN Verification solution among banks, fintechs, e-commerce platforms, payroll providers, lending companies, and corporate clients across KSA.
Conduct outbound sales activity (calls, LinkedIn outreach, in-person meetings, and field visits) to build a healthy and continuously refreshed pipeline.
Deliver compelling product demonstrations of the IBAN Verification API/solution, articulating its value in reducing payment errors, preventing fraud, and improving customer onboarding accuracy.
Negotiate commercial terms within approved guidelines and close deals to meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Coordinate with the onboarding, compliance, and technical integration teams to ensure smooth client activation and time-to-first-API-call.
Build and maintain strong long-term relationships with clients to support upselling, cross-selling, and account retention as they scale their verification volumes.
Stay current on open banking developments in KSA, SAMA's Open Banking Framework, IBAN Verification use cases, competitor offerings, and account validation trends.
Represent the company professionally at industry events, expos, and partner meetings to expand brand visibility and the sales pipeline.
